Concrete work and floor coatings.

Two kinds of job. New concrete poured where you need it, or a hard wearing coat on a floor you already have.

  • Concrete driveways, patios and slabs

    New concrete for a driveway, the back patio, a walkway or a slab for a garage or shop. The ground is usually graded and a gravel base laid before the pour, and then the top gets the finish you choose.

    Pick this job

  • Stamped and finished concrete

    Stamping presses a pattern into the concrete while it is still soft, so a patio or path can look like stone or brick. Plainer finishes include a broom finish for grip and a smooth trowel finish.

    Pick this job

  • Coatings for garage and shop floors

    A coating goes over the bare concrete of a garage or shop floor. It leaves a sealed, glossy surface that is easy to sweep and mop, and it can carry a colour or a flake finish.

    Pick this job

Concrete or coating?

They are two different jobs. Flatwork is new concrete. A coating goes on top of concrete that is already there.

Sample photo

Flatwork

New concrete, poured in place

Flatwork is any flat slab on the ground, like a driveway, a patio, a walkway or a garage floor. It is poured and levelled where it sits, and it needs time to cure before it can take the weight of a car.

Fits when
The old slab is broken up, or there is no slab yet.

Sample photo

Floor coating

A new top for a sound slab

A floor coating is a thin layer, often epoxy or polyaspartic, that bonds to a clean slab once the surface has been ground or etched. It seals the concrete against oil and water and gives a glossy finish that wipes clean.

Fits when
The slab is solid but stained or dusty.

Slab layers

What sits under a finished floor. Tap a layer to see what it does.

Coating

A coating is rolled onto clean, prepared concrete and bonds to the top of the slab, which seals it and makes it easier to clean.

Concrete slab

Joints cut into the slab give it a planned place to crack as the concrete dries and shrinks.

Gravel base

A layer of compacted gravel under the slab gives it firm, even support and lets water drain away.
